name: CM-11 Brave Tiger
protection: M48 turret on M60 hull with M1-derived fire control. Game: immune to all small-calibre rounds; 7.62x54R and 12.7/14.5 mm damage optics, stowage and tracks; every launcher in the game (PG-7V, AT4, MAAWS, SMAW, NLAW, Javelin) penetrates from any arc, frontal hull included at close range.
visual_notes: M48-style rounded cast turret on a longer M60A3 hull
Six road wheels per side with return rollers
Fire control and laser rangefinder housing in front of commander; about 450 in service with no upgrade planned
